name: 陈晓军
major: 妇产科学，子宫内膜癌临床与基础研究，保留生育功能治疗

paper_description: 近5年在Nature Genetics, Nature Communication等主流期刊发表论著40余篇
致力于内膜癌保育临床和基础研究，建立国内首个子宫内膜癌保留生育功能多学科诊疗平台，牵头制定子宫内膜癌保留生育功能多学科诊疗中国专家共识，创建手术+药物治疗进行内膜癌保育新方案，使内膜癌保育完全缓解率达95%以上，妊娠率超过60%
保育创新成果被欧洲妇科肿瘤协会和加拿大妇科肿瘤协会等四项指南采纳

She leads the ongoing multi-centered randomized clinical trial ‘Sentinel lymph Node mapping vs systematic pelvic lymphadenectomy on the prognosis for patients with intermediate-high-risk Endometrial Cancer confined to the uterus before surgery: a multi-center, non-inferiority, randomized controlled trial (SNEC trial), NCT04276532)
Dr. Xiaojun Chen investigates the relationship between metabolic disorder and endometrial cancer and tries to dig out the mechanisms lying behind the oncogenesis of endometrial cancer.
projects: 作为课题负责人承担国家重点专项课题两项
上海市科委重点项目等共15项
Her research is supported by grants from National Key Research and Development Program of China, National Natural Science Foundation of China as well as Shanghai Scientific and Technique Committee.
